Reported Kenneth Walker ruled out, Emmett Johnson starting; AJ Brown expected to miss multiple weeks.

items.text: Chiefs ruled out RB Kenneth Walker for Sunday’s game vs. the Cardinals due to his groin injury. It will be the second straight game he missed with rookie RB Emmett Johnson starting again.
items.why: Ruled out for Sunday due to groin injury; second straight game missed.
items.implication: Rookie Emmett Johnson starts as the lead back again.
items.opportunity: Consider Emmett Johnson as a waiver pickup for volume boost if available.

items.text: AJ Brown is expected to miss multiple weeks due to his hamstring injury, per @MikeReiss and me.
items.why: Hamstring injury expected to sideline him for multiple weeks.
items.implication: Opponent loses starting WR AJ Brown for this week and beyond.
items.opportunity: Matchup advantage for JD against King Kong this week.
